snippet.title: The Type IX: Distant Coasts DLC - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The Type IX: Distant Coasts DLC for UBOAT is out now! 🥳

Take  command of the Type IX - the largest, longest-range U-boat ever added  to the game. Built for ocean-going operations far beyond the North  Atlantic, this boat can reach waters most commanders only dreamed of. ⛵

Patrol off South Africa, operate from a Japanese-held port in Penang,  and undertake daring rescue missions off North America. 🚢⚓

New campaigns,  historical events, and entire theaters of war are now within reach.

🌊 The open ocean is calling — available now on Steam.
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3985670/UBOAT__Type_IX_Distant_Coasts
